riddle.clue: A billionaire genius fights crime in a mechanical suit, then turns out to also be a Kryptonian superhero known for near invulnerability.
riddle.solution: What is Iron Man of Steel? (Iron Man + Man of Steel)

riddle.clue: A sitcom about a widowed father raising three daughters with help from friends becomes a Netflix political thriller about a ruthless congressman's rise to power.
riddle.solution: What is Full House of Cards? (Full House + House of Cards)

riddle.clue: A chemistry teacher turns to cooking meth to secure his family's future, in a story that becomes a Lady Gaga song about a toxic relationship.
riddle.solution: What is Breaking Bad Romance? (Breaking Bad + Bad Romance)

riddle.clue: A boy helps a captive orca return to the ocean, in a story that becomes about an eccentric chocolatier running mysterious factory tours.
riddle.solution: What is Free Willy Wonka? (Free Willy + Willy Wonka)

riddle.clue: A boy who sees dead people stars in a twist-ending thriller, that becomes a Jane Austen novel about two sisters navigating romance and social expectation.
riddle.solution: What is The Sixth Sense and Sensibility? (The Sixth Sense + Sense and Sensibility)

riddle.clue: This year, the Berlin Wall fell, paving the way for German reunification.
This year, the first iPhone went on sale.
This year, the Chernobyl nuclear disaster occurred in Soviet Ukraine.
This year, the Wright brothers achieved the first powered, controlled airplane flight.
This year, sliced bread was first sold commercially, giving rise to the phrase used to praise any great invention.
In this country, parents must choose baby names from an approved list, or submit new ones for review by a national naming committee.
In this country, it's illegal to keep certain social animals, like guinea pigs, completely alone, since animal welfare law requires them to have companionship.
In this country, the sale and import of chewing gum has been tightly restricted since 1992 to keep public spaces clean.
In this country, it's illegal to run out of fuel on a certain stretch of motorway, since stopping unnecessarily there is considered a serious hazard.
In this country, it's illegal to pay a bill of more than 25 cents entirely in pennies, under a law governing legal tender.
Never trim a single piece of yourself for over thirty years, until doing basically anything with your hands becomes an ordeal.
riddle.solution: What is the world record for longest fingernails?

riddle.clue: Turn an entire form of transportation into a very slow, very metal-heavy meal over several weeks.
riddle.solution: What is the world record for eating a bicycle?

riddle.clue: Make a noise with your own mouth loud enough to rival a power tool
riddle.solution: What is the world record for loudest burp?

riddle.clue: Turn your own face into improvised kitchen storage, using nothing but static electricity and stubbornness.
riddle.solution: What is the world record for most spoons balanced on the face?

riddle.clue: Cover your own face with as many small, shelled mollusks as will stay put in sixty seconds.
riddle.solution: What is the world record for most snails balanced on the face?

A woman falls through white rooms because science, occasionally getting yelled at by a paranoid potato.
Punch a man in a diving suit while genetically modified children stab corpses with needles for you.
Ruin strangers' days with a rubber stamp so your cartoon family doesn't freeze to death.
A man carries boxes across post-apocalyptic America while a baby in a jar helps him see ghosts.
